anemia.recommendation: Repeat CBC monitoring, review iron intake, and follow up clinically if fatigue or paleness persists.

diabetes.recommendation: Continue glucose monitoring, prioritize balanced meals and activity, and discuss follow-up testing with your clinician.

cardiovascular.recommendation: Review diet, exercise, and lipid follow-up planning with your clinician, especially if LDL or triglycerides remain elevated.

kidney.recommendation: Monitor kidney markers on future panels and discuss follow-up if creatinine trends upward.
